title: FlySandboxEnvironment provider
description:
Implement Fly.io cloud sandbox environment provider at internal/sandbox/environment/fly/.

Most complex remote provider: Fly Machines API for lifecycle + SSH-based tool execution with pinned host key verification. Include mocked tests and compliance test suite integration.
